content:
"""
title: Sports Score Tool
author: greg
description: Placeholder for live sports scores - honestly reports that real-time lookups aren't supported yet and points the user to a manual source, pending a decision on which sports data API/tier to integrate
version: 1.1.0
"""

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class Tools:
    class Valves(BaseModel):
        fallback_url: str = Field(
            default="https://www.espn.com/",
            description="URL to point users to for scores until real sports data integration is built",
        )

    def __init__(self):
        self.valves = self.Valves()
        self.citation = True

    def get_sports_score(self, team_or_league: str) -> str:
        """
        Use for any sports score, game result, or standings question (e.g. "Packers score", "Bundesliga table"). Never use web_search for these - this tool is authoritative for sports data.

        :param team_or_league: The team or league the user asked about, e.g. "Packers", "Premier League", "Bundesliga"
        :return: An honest message explaining that live sports data isn't integrated yet, with a link to check manually.
        """
        return (
            f"I don't have live sports data integrated yet, so I can't look up the score for "
            f"'{team_or_league}' directly. A free/paid sports API integration (e.g. TheSportsDB, "
            f"SportRadar, or API-Sports) is planned but not built yet - a prior free-tier attempt "
            f"restricted current-season data and had unreliable team-name matching, so this is on "
            f"hold pending a better source. In the meantime, check {self.valves.fallback_url} directly "
            f"for current scores."
        )
